name: search_hardware
description: Find GPUs, Apple Silicon Macs and unified-memory machines (Strix Halo, DGX/RTX Spark) the Will It Run? checker knows, with memory, GPU-usable memory and bandwidth. Use the returned id as `hw` in check_fit / what_fits.

query.description: Words to match, any order, e.g. "3090", "m4 max 128", "strix". Empty = all.

name: search_models
description: Find open-weight LLMs in the Will It Run? database (params, MoE, release date, max context). Use the returned slug as `model` in check_fit.

query.description: Words to match in name/slug/HF repo, e.g. "qwen 32b", "deepseek".

name: check_fit
description: Will this model run on this hardware? Returns verdict (fits / tight / offload / no), memory needed vs GPU-usable memory (estimates), placement for RAM offload (MoE experts-to-RAM like llama.cpp --cpu-moe, or layer split), measured or estimated generation speed, and a checker deep link. Give `model` (slug) OR `hf` + `file` (any Hugging Face GGUF repo/file, sized from the real file). Omit `quant` to get the best quant that fits.

hw.description: Hardware id(s) from search_hardware. Comma-separate for multi-GPU, e.g. "rtx-3090,rtx-3090". Custom VRAM: "custom-48" (48 GB, no specific card) or "rtx-3090:30" (that card's chip with 30 GB).

file.description: GGUF file name in that repo (split files: the name without -0000N-of-0000M). Omit to list files.

quant.description: Quant for `model`, e.g. Q4_K_M, IQ4_XS, Q8_0, F16. Omit for best fit.

minq.description: Lowest quant allowed when picking best fit (default all).

ram.description: System RAM in GB available for offload (discrete GPUs only). Default 0 = no offload.

rambw.description: RAM bandwidth in GB/s for offload speed estimates. One of: 25.6, 29.9, 51.2, 59.7, 25, 50, 80, 102.4, 153.6, 204.8, 307.2, 460.8, 576. Default 50.

engram.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Engram table: resident in GPU memory (default) or offloaded to RAM/disk.

name: what_fits
description: List the models that fit on this hardware (best quant each), fully on GPU first, then with RAM offload, biggest first. Includes speed where known and checker deep links.

hw.description: Hardware id(s) from search_hardware. Comma-separate for multi-GPU, e.g. "rtx-3090,rtx-3090". Custom VRAM: "custom-48" (48 GB, no specific card) or "rtx-3090:30" (that card's chip with 30 GB).

minq.description: Lowest quant allowed (default q3 = IQ3_XXS or better).

ram.description: System RAM in GB available for offload (discrete GPUs only). Default 0 = no offload.

rambw.description: RAM bandwidth in GB/s for offload speed estimates. One of: 25.6, 29.9, 51.2, 59.7, 25, 50, 80, 102.4, 153.6, 204.8, 307.2, 460.8, 576. Default 50.

engram.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Engram table: resident in GPU memory (default) or offloaded to RAM/disk.

name: get_benchmarks
description: Measured community llama.cpp benchmarks (tg128 = generation tok/s, pp512 = prompt tok/s), each with its source link. Filter by hardware id, model slug and/or quant.

model.description: Model slug (or benchmark key such as llama2-7b).
